text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated monocytes and basophils, increased D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, and INR. These findings suggest a significant inflammatory response, possible infection or systemic inflammation, and a risk of coagulopathy. The pattern is compatible with severe viral infection (e.g., COVID-19) or other causes of acute systemic inflammation. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
